acceptance_criteria: Wallet balances and transaction amounts use unsigned integer Toman values; write operations lock the user row and update the balance and ledger within a database transaction. Cover integer bounds, rollback, and concurrent writes on MySQL.
test_or_validation: WalletServiceTest verifies balance/ledger updates and snapshots; WalletConcurrentDebitTest's latest isolated MySQL 8.4/InnoDB run passed all three scenarios (48 assertions): concurrent overdraw prevention, one-row debit retry and one-row verified credit for a shared gateway reference. Production load and broader rollback paths remain unverified.

acceptance_criteria: Only verified gateway success credits a wallet top-up; gateway plus reference is idempotent. An external subscription payment is recorded in the ledger without changing wallet balance; there is no public balance-credit endpoint.
test_or_validation: WalletServiceTest verifies successful gateway credit, idempotent external subscription purchase recording, same-reference replay, conflict on changed amount, and unchanged wallet balance for external purchases. WalletConcurrentDebitTest also verifies two concurrent verified credits for the same user/reference return one transaction and increase the balance once on MySQL/InnoDB (five runs). Cross-user/type conflicts, database rollback and provider-callback integration remain.

acceptance_criteria: Purchase debit is atomic, requires a positive integer amount, rejects insufficient funds, requires a UUID idempotency key and purchase reference, and accepts an exact replay only within 24 hours; conflicting or expired replays are rejected.
test_or_validation: WalletServiceTest verifies successful purchase debit, exact idempotent replay, changed-amount conflict, insufficient balance and unchanged balance/ledger on rejection. WalletConcurrentDebitTest verifies concurrent identical requests produce one debit and one persisted transaction on MySQL/InnoDB. Expired and cross-user idempotency keys remain.

acceptance_criteria: A successful wallet debit can be refunded once; refund atomically credits the balance, marks the debit refunded, and links one reversal transaction. Only definitive failure paths should invoke the refund.
test_or_validation: WalletServiceTest verifies a successful purchase debit is refunded once, restores balance atomically, updates the debit status, and links one reversal row. Add tests for ineligible debit states, overflow/rollback and definitive versus ambiguous payment outcomes.

acceptance_criteria: Authenticated wallet endpoints return the current user's balance/currency/unit and paginated transaction history; history is scoped to that user and omits gateway references, idempotency keys, and balance_after.
test_or_validation: FinancialAuditVisibilityTest verifies ordinary-user transaction history omits balance_after. Add API tests for ownership isolation, pagination bounds/defaults, amount/response shape, and absence of private ledger identifiers.

acceptance_criteria: The admin transaction endpoint requires view transactions permission and supports user/type/status/date filters and bounded pagination; the admin resource exposes reconciliation references and balance_after to authorized auditors, but not idempotency keys.
test_or_validation: FinancialAuditVisibilityTest verifies that an unauthorized user is denied and an authorized auditor receives balance_after. Add filter/date-boundary, invalid-input, pagination, and remaining response-privacy tests.

acceptance_criteria: Subscription purchase applies the wallet contribution under the user lock, sends only the remainder to the gateway, and records the order, wallet transaction, and gateway attempts distinctly; wallet-only purchases do not initiate a gateway attempt.
test_or_validation: PaymentServiceTest verifies mixed and wallet-only purchases, exact wallet/gateway amounts and callback activation; add zero-wallet/full-gateway subscription purchase and gateway-only failure/recovery cases.

acceptance_criteria: Ambiguous gateway initiation does not automatically start a duplicate payment or refund. Definitive failure atomically fails the order, refunds an eligible wallet debit once, and releases its discount reservation; verified success records the external payment and activates the subscription.
test_or_validation: PaymentServiceTest verifies ambiguous initiation handling/recovery, successful/failed top-up callbacks, subscription compensation, wallet refund/discount release and replay. ZarinpalGatewayTest now confirms that NOK requires provider Inquiry before terminal failure: IN_BANK leaves attempt/order pending and preserves wallet debit and discount reservation; PAID proceeds through server Verify; FAILED/REVERSED are terminal. MySQL concurrency tests cover contradictory callbacks and initiation races. Provider-specific terminality was exercised with HTTP fakes, not live Zarinpal.

acceptance_criteria: Top-up and subscription purchase require a UUID Idempotency-Key scoped to the user; replay must match the original amount or quote/order inputs, and responses must not expose the key. Attempts and orders retain expiry metadata.
test_or_validation: PaymentServiceTest verifies wallet top-up requires a UUID key at service boundary, exact replay returns the original pending attempt without a second gateway initiation, changed-amount replay conflicts, and ambiguous initiation is not retried. Subscription purchase quote matching, cross-user scope, terminal failures, and API validation remain.

acceptance_criteria: Withdrawal requests are disabled by default, can be enabled through wallet settings, validate a positive amount against the configured per-request limit, reserve available balance atomically, and use a user-scoped UUID idempotency key for 24 hours. The approved daily-limit policy counts pending, approved_pending_payout, and paid requests.
test_or_validation: WithdrawalRequestPolicyTest verifies disabled-by-default behavior, daily cap status/date boundaries, configured per-request limits, insufficient balance, idempotency replay/conflict and SQLite-injected atomic rollback. A defect found during verification was corrected: idempotency lookup now scopes by user, matching the documented user-scoped contract and composite unique key. WithdrawalRateLimitTest verifies five accepted requests then 429 without extra hold/balance change. WithdrawalRequestConcurrencyTest passed all three tests on isolated MySQL/InnoDB (103 assertions), including concurrent requests, replay and five approve/reject race rounds. Remaining: boundary/accounting cases beyond current daily-cap test and wider failure/concurrency coverage.

acceptance_criteria: Withdrawal review endpoints require manage wallet permission and allow valid state transitions; rejection releases the hold exactly once, while approval only marks approved_pending_payout and does not execute a bank payout. User requests are isolated to the authenticated user.
test_or_validation: WithdrawalRateLimitTest verifies independent action buckets and thresholds. WithdrawalReviewLifecycleTest verifies permission denial, user-history isolation, queue exclusion of rejected requests, approval without payout, rejection release exactly once, conflicting replays and rollback after injected release failure. WithdrawalRequestConcurrencyTest passed all three tests (103 assertions) on disposable MySQL/InnoDB; five approve/reject race rounds ended rejected with exactly one hold release and no payout. External payout verification remains.

acceptance_criteria: SendOtpSms implements ShouldBeEncrypted and sends only when the referenced OTP still exists, is unused, matches the stored hash and has not expired; expired OTPs are invalidated without sending.

acceptance_criteria: Job configures three attempts, 20-second timeout and backoffs [10, 30]; modeled maximum execution plus backoff budget is 100 seconds against a five-minute OTP TTL. Delayed handling at exact expiry suppresses sending; database queue retry_after is 90 seconds, greater than the 20-second timeout. Real worker was verified to call the provider three times and exhaust retries; retry waits were advanced through isolated queue timestamps, not elapsed in real time. Other queue drivers and concurrent duplicate delivery remain unverified.
test_or_validation: SendOtpSmsJobTest checks retry/expiry timing and budgets; QueuedOtpSmsWorkerTest uses Laravel queue:work --once for three attempts with a failing fake provider and verifies the row moves to failed_jobs. No real-time delay or production backend integration.
